[SWS_DM_00940] Re-entrant ara::diag interface calls for service pro- cessing
⌈
The DM shall only call a method on an interface for service processing in a
re-entrant way, if the DM is
• in default session and
• multiple conversation requests are being processed simultaneously and
• the requested diagnostic service requires that the DM is calling the same required
port for different clients and
• the interface constructor has the parameter ara::diag::ReentrancyType
and
• the value of this parameter is set to kFully.
⌋
